mapper.sql: id, config_name, config_key, config_value, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys_config WHERE deleted = 0
AND config_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{configName}, '%')
AND config_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{configKey}, '%')
SELECT FROM sys_config WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_name, config_key, config_value, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version) VALUES (#{configName}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{version}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_config SET deleted = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
